# tenzir_demo_organization (Resource)

Tenzir-internal: the organization every new user of the platform joins on signing up, to look around in, and the custom role they get there, which decides what they may see. A platform has at most one, so declare this resource once; a second one replaces the first's setting. Members who joined before stay when it changes or goes.

Needs `Root.readDemoOrgSetup`, `Root.setDemoOrgSetup` and `Root.removeDemoOrgSetup`, which only platform administrators hold. Deleting the organization or the role makes the platform forget the setting, which the next plan shows.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Tenzir-internal. Terraform runs as a platform administrator: it sets the
# organization up, makes its own user the owner, gives visitors a role, and
# then makes the organization the one every new user joins.
resource "tenzir_organization" "demo" {
  slug = "demo"
  name = "Demo"
  plan = "provisioned"
}

data "tenzir_current_user" "terraform" {}

resource "tenzir_organization_member" "terraform" {
  organization_id = tenzir_organization.demo.id
  user_id         = data.tenzir_current_user.terraform.id
  role_ids        = ["org.owner"]
}

resource "tenzir_role" "visitor" {
  organization_id = tenzir_organization.demo.id
  label           = "Visitor"
  color           = "neutral"
  policy = jsonencode([
    [{ target = { _tag = "Organization", orgId = tenzir_organization.demo.id }, relationships = [] }, ["Organization.read", "Organization.listWorkspaces"]],
  ])

  # The platform refuses role changes while nobody can restore access.
  depends_on = [tenzir_organization_member.terraform]
}

resource "tenzir_demo_organization" "this" {
  organization_id = tenzir_organization.demo.id
  role_id         = tenzir_role.visitor.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String) The ID of the organization; not its slug.
- `role_id` (String) The ID of a custom role of the organization, which new users get there.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the demo organization.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The platform has at most one demo organization, so any ID imports it.
terraform import tenzir_demo_organization.this demo
```
